args.message: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money, per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but per FIN-212 the nightly build expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This change updates the rounding mode, which fixes the failing test in `tests/test_money.py`:

- `round_money(Decimal("2.675"))` → `2.68`
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` → `2.66` (previously returned `2.67`)

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
